# lean-constellation target: `rootedNonroot_inverse_quadratic_sigma_of_child_admissible`

Let `V` be a finite type with decidable equality, let `G` be a simple graph on `V` with decidable
adjacency, let `hG : G.IsTree`, let `w : V → ℤ`, and let `ρ : V`. Put

`R := {v : V // v ≠ ρ}` and `I := {c : V // c ∈ rootedChildren G hG ρ ρ}`.

Use one shared let-bound canonical `Fintype.ofFinite` instance and the established deleted-edge
`DecidableRel` convention for the entire attached-child family. Assume exactly

`∀ c : I, IsAdmissibleRootedTree (rootedChildComponent G ρ c.1).toSimpleGraph (fun x => w (x : V))
(rootedChildRoot G ρ c.1)`.

No ambient hypothesis `IsAdmissibleRootedTree G w ρ` is assumed. Define the nonroot principal block
verbatim by

`D := (rootedGram G w).submatrix Subtype.val Subtype.val`.

Then the unchanged ambient rational inverse quadratic double sum equals the canonical finite sum
over the attached-child subtype:

`∑ x : R, ∑ y : R, rootedGram G w ρ (x : V) * D⁻¹ x y * rootedGram G w (y : V) ρ = ∑ c in
Finset.univ, rootedChildCapacitySummand G hG w ρ c`.

The right-hand sum uses the exact canonical attached-child index and the same shared local instances
as the pointwise premise and `rootedChildCapacitySummand`. The assertion does not restate
`rootedChildCapacitySum`; it is precisely the Sigma/root-row transport needed to obtain that public
conclusion by unfolding the existing sum definition.

theorem rootedNonroot_inverse_quadratic_sigma_of_child_admissible {V : Type*} [Fintype V]
    [DecidableEq V] (G : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel G.Adj] (hG : G.IsTree) (w : V → ℤ)
    (ρ : V) :
    let R := {v : V // v ≠ ρ}
    let I := {c : V // c ∈ rootedChildren G hG ρ ρ}
    letI : Fintype R := Fintype.ofFinite R
    letI : Fintype I := Fintype.ofFinite I
    letI : ∀ c : I, Fintype (rootedChildComponent G ρ c.1) :=
      fun c => Fintype.ofFinite _
    letI : ∀ c : I, DecidableRel (rootedChildComponent G ρ c.1).toSimpleGraph.Adj := fun c => by
      intro x y
      change Decidable ((G.deleteEdges {s(ρ, c.1)}).Adj (x : V) (y : V))
      infer_instance
    let D : Matrix R R ℚ := (rootedGram G w).submatrix Subtype.val Subtype.val
    (∀ c : I, IsAdmissibleRootedTree (rootedChildComponent G ρ c.1).toSimpleGraph
      (fun x => w (x : V)) (rootedChildRoot G ρ c.1)) →
      ∑ x : R, ∑ y : R,
        rootedGram G w ρ (x : V) * D⁻¹ x y * rootedGram G w (y : V) ρ =
          ∑ c ∈ Finset.univ, rootedChildCapacitySummand G hG w ρ c := by
  sorry
